descriptions.w3d_cc34b_movie_init_802e02ec: Initializes the movie player with original 416-byte state and 96-byte auxiliary allocations, zeroes movie state, initializes movie/audio services and preserves failure returns. Successful initialization sets mode2, a zero step, zero duration and both volume fields to127.0, independently decoded from original DOL constants803db050/803db054. Repeated initialization logs the original warning. Explicit field views describe observed offsets, not a complete original class size; external routines/data remain unowned.
